_comment: JSON, not YAML: Blender's bundled Python has no PyYAML. Consumed by scripts/render_stereo.py, NOT by load_config. See configs/scene/material_chart.yaml for the experiment-side settings.
_convergence: 2.5 m sits behind the 1.6 m backdrop. A fixation plane inside the scene gives disparity 0 there, which the matcher discards as a search-range endpoint; render_stereo.py refuses such a value outright.
_samples: 512 with denoising off. Denoising would smooth the beauty pass and supply spatial structure to exactly the low-texture patches under test, so noise is reduced by sampling instead.
